fact: During the suspension of the Race, mechanics of the Oracle Red Bull Racing Team were working on car number 6 during the race suspension other than as permitted under the regulations.
offence: Alleged breach of Article B5.14.4.a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representatives and the FIA Technical Delegate, and reviewed photo evidence. The team were reported as attempting to change spark plugs/coils but did not proceed with the change and the car started in the same condition as it arrived in the pits, therefore no further action is taken.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Alleged Red Flag Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
